text:
olivia: FWIW hit a weird interaction between context cancellation, streaming generator, and token auto-refresh in the Go SDK sample app. Posting repro + logs.

sam: Can you paste a minimal repro? Is this on the latest go-sdk?

olivia: Yes, go-sdk v0.8.1. Repro steps: run sample-generator/main.go, start a generator stream, then force our token source to rotate (simulate credential refresh). After that, cancel the ctx. Sometimes the stream goroutine never returns and goroutine count creeps up.

miguel: Oof. Any logs or a snippet?

olivia: Minimal snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
defer cancel()
gen, err := client.Generator(ctx, model)
if err != nil { return err }
stream, err := gen.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for ev := range stream.Events() {
    fmt.Println(ev.Text)
}
```
Token source is oauth2.ReuseTokenSource which refreshes in background.

miguel: Any stack traces?

olivia: paste from the hang: 
```
goroutine 72 [chan receive]:
net/http.(*persistConn).readLoop(0xc0001a4000)
    /usr/local/go/src/net/http/transport.go:xxxx +0xabc
created by net/http.(*Transport).dialConn
    /usr/local/go/src/net/http/transport.go:xxxx +0xdef
```
And app logs: "stream read loop: read tcp 10.0.0.5:443: i/o timeout" then nothing.

anna: Is this similar to the old handshake/cancel propagation problem? Could be the auth refresh blocking the stream's internal retry loop.

jeff: Suggestion: ensure token refresh and retry backoff accept ctx and return quickly on ctx.Done. Also possible to call stream.Close() on ctx.Done as a stopgap.

olivia: Tried calling stream.Close() in a goroutine on ctx.Done. Close() sometimes deadlocks when retry is mid-auth refresh — I think the auth token retrieval path isn't passing through ctx.

dev-bot: CI test generator-stream-auth #432 failed on main (flaky).

miguel: I can reproduce locally. I'll add a unit test that spins up a fake token source which blocks on refresh, then asserts that cancel closes the stream and goroutines drop. Proposed fix: make our token fetch path context-aware and thread cancel into retry/backoff so Close() unblocks.

sam: Ping @eng-runtime — this touches the transport + retry wrapper.

olivia: Opening a PR with failing test + repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/789 (draft).

jeff: :thumbsup: Assigning to miguel for patch, anna for review.

anna: Will review. Also a UX thought: expose Stream.WithContext(ctx) or document that streams are context-bound and token rotation can interact poorly with long-lived streams. That might help onboarding.

miguel: Working on the PR now. Plan: (1) failing unit test, (2) fix to make token retrieval and retry loops accept ctx, (3) update sample app to show proper cancellation pattern, (4) changelog note.

olivia: Confirmed the branch fixes my repro — stream goroutine exits after cancel now. Running stress test for a few minutes.

sam: Nice. Please add a small note in the onboarding docs about token rotation + streaming gotchas and recommended pattern.

olivia: Will follow up with a doc patch. Thanks folks. :pray:
